title: Three-tag Praxis with concurrent search and 21 aligned quotient chunks
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5608 MiB (5.4765 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 21689 million field multiplications (14649 and 7041), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
